categories.main_business_segments: Guming Holdings Limited primarily operates in the freshly-made tea beverage industry in China, focusing on the mid-priced segment. The company runs a franchised retail network under the 'Good me' brand, offering freshly-made tea, fruit tea, milk tea, and coffee beverages. It also engages in the trading of ingredients, equipment sales, and provision of franchise management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary technologies including in-house developed store management systems integrated with IoT-enabled appliances such as proprietary tea brewers that ensure consistent beverage quality. It operates a sophisticated cold-chain warehousing and logistics infrastructure to maintain freshness of short-shelf-life ingredients like fresh fruits, tea leaves, and milk. The company also invests in food science research and collaborates with universities to innovate and optimize product offerings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Guming serves primarily franchisees who operate its stores, and through them, end consumers seeking freshly-made tea and coffee beverages. Its key market is the mid-priced freshly-made tea beverage segment in China, targeting consumers across all city tiers, with a strong presence in second-tier and below cities and towns. The company also targets emerging consumer groups through online and offline marketing integration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Mainland China, with a store network spanning over 200 cities across all city tiers. It has established provincewide networks with critical mass in eight provinces, accounting for 83% of its gross merchandise value (GMV). The company plans to expand into 17 additional provinces and explore overseas markets with growth potential.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guming operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, managing procurement, processing, warehousing, logistics, and distribution of fresh ingredients and equipment to franchised stores. It owns and leases warehouses and operates a fleet of temperature-controlled vehicles to ensure cold-chain delivery, supporting franchisees with centralized sourcing and supply chain services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding its store network with a regional densification strategy, improving operating efficiency, and enhancing product offerings through continuous R&D in food science. It invests in proprietary technology to digitalize operations and improve franchisee management. Future R&D includes refining existing products, launching new beverages including coffee, and deepening collaborations with academic institutions to innovate.
categories.revenue_model: Guming generates revenue mainly from sales of goods (ingredients and packaging), equipment (such as coffee machines), and franchise management services to its franchisees. The majority of revenue comes from franchised stores, with a small portion from company-operated stores. Revenue growth is driven by store network expansion and increased gross merchandise value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guming is positioned as a leading and fast-growing player in China's mid-priced freshly-made tea beverage market, which is highly competitive and fragmented. It differentiates itself through its extensive franchise network, strong supply chain capabilities, and technology integration. The company faces competition from numerous tea brands, including those offering low-priced products, and emphasizes quality and brand reputation to maintain its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Guming reported revenue of RMB 8.79 billion, a 14.5% increase year-on-year, and net profit of RMB 1.49 billion, up 36.2%. The company operates nearly 10,000 stores with a 10.1% annual net increase. It has demonstrated steady growth in scale and profitability, with adjusted profit margins around 17.5%. The company maintains a prudent financial position with a gearing ratio of 23.0% as of 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guming emphasizes delivering fresh, tasty, and value-for-money beverages with consistent high quality, supported by a rigorous quality control system and proprietary brewing technology. Its regional densification strategy ensures store density and supply chain efficiency, enabling freshness and competitive pricing. The company fosters close franchisee relationships and leverages technology for operational consistency and consumer engagement, differentiating itself in a crowded market.
